purposes.seed: Reproduces the same authored kit without changing world placement seeds.
purposes.radial_sides: Smooth enough working surfaces at hand distance while keeping a small shared mesh budget.
purposes.bark_ridge: Restrained longitudinal relief avoids smooth pipe-like roots.
purposes.root_arch_width_m/root_arch_height_m: The authored elder envelope and crown junction; asymmetric buttress roots make a walkable irregular chamber beneath a living bole.
purposes.hollow_trunk_height_m: A broken, thick-walled fen trunk with low papery growth; the uneven rim remains below the canopy.
purposes.stone_rib_height_m: Broad eroded sedimentary shelves replace repeated pointed cones along the upland skyline.
purposes.palette: Earthy bark, aged paper, milky glass and dark iron distinguish physical jobs; warm cream light is separated from fire and frost danger colours.
purposes.ventlung_curve_steps: Four spans per rib segment make the existing membrane curved rather than angular; nine radial sides retain readable pleats.
purposes.ventlung_retained_bounds: Measured a7c3854 mesh envelope. Curved ribs are fitted to the same ground pivot and extents; runtime body, finish, work and stock are unchanged.
